name: Buyer Protection Instruction Details 1
definition: Information received for a given buyer protection instruction.

BuyerProtectionInstructionIdentification.name: Buyer Protection Instruction Identification
BuyerProtectionInstructionIdentification.definition: Identification of the related buyer protection instruction document for which the cancellation is requested.

RelatedSettlementInstructionIdentificati.name: Related Settlement Instruction Identification
RelatedSettlementInstructionIdentificati.definition: Set of elements used to identify the buyer protected settlement instruction.

CounterpartyDepository.name: Counterparty Depository
CounterpartyDepository.definition: First receiving party in the settlement chain. In a plain vanilla settlement, it is the central securities depository where the receiving side of the transaction requests to receive the financial instrument.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Selected safekeeping accounts list to which the corporate action event applies.

InstructionProcessingStatus.name: Instruction Processing Status
InstructionProcessingStatus.definition: Information about the processing status of the instruction.
